replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Although I can't see any iron (which is good), team Killing is an issue, along with blocking spawn with lava (and even spawn killing with it). If buckets + iron is unavailable, this isn't too big of an issue, but it's still something that we would need to look out for.

Also, little unsure about the gameplay, but I can't see it being too bad. Aesthetically, this is not one of your best maps. It doesn't look horrendous though, which is always a good thing. Lanes need a little more decorating though. :3 Maybe a couple more spots of water?

EDIT: Lane designs mostly make up for the aesthetics, but I feel that there could still be some things added, that won't have a big impact on gameplay.
